scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,back,front -c blue,green,magenta "npm run docker:up" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d postgres minio minio-init
